description: This file defines classes and structures related to audio commands in the cuttlefish project, including command types for controlling audio streams, retrieving information about audio channels, jacks, and PCM info, as well as setting stream parameters.

classes.name: AudioCommand
classes.description: Base class for audio commands, managing command type and status.

classes.name: InfoCommand
classes.description: Template class for commands that retrieve information, parameterized by reply type.

classes.name: ChmapInfoCommand
classes.description: Command to retrieve channel map information.

classes.name: StreamInfoCommand
classes.description: Command to retrieve PCM stream information.

classes.name: StreamControlCommand
classes.description: Superclass for stream control commands like start, stop, prepare, release.

classes.name: StreamSetParamsCommand
classes.description: Command to set parameters for a specific audio stream.

methods.name: Reply
methods.description: Method to send a reply with a given status and data.
